notes: Real files from ANVISA's open-data server, https://dados.anvisa.gov.br/dados/ (CONSULTAS/PRODUTOS/ for the product files, the root for the petition files; no auth). The CSVs are too big to keep, so headers_*.txt holds the response headers and *_head.csv the header row plus a handful of records copied byte for byte (never re-encode them; .gitattributes marks them -text). Records were chosen to cover the format's edge cases: Windows-1252 bytes 0x92/0x96/0x99, quotes inside quoted fields that ANVISA does not escape, line breaks inside fields, HTML entities in MARCAS and NO_PRODUTO, DT_VENCIMENTO_REGISTRO as MMYYYY and MM/YYYY, ST_PRODUTO_ATIVO = X, CNPJs with leading zeros, and resultado rows that join main rows on CO_SEQ_APRESENTACAO_PRODUTO.

responses.name: saneantes
responses.note: 24,570,558 bytes, not kept; 23 records chosen for: CNPJs with leading zeros, inactive products, cp1252 bytes, line breaks and CRLF in names, registrados, inner quotes, a 10-digit registro, a 14-digit processo, a 3033 expiry, empty expiries, a notificado with a registro, ‏ in a name, and `"AS MENINAS"` followed by CRLF CRLF inside a quoted name
